159	function projectStrict(history: readonly ContextMessage[], onAnomaly?: OnAnomaly): Message[] {
160	  const projected = project(history, onAnomaly);

167	function dedupeDuplicateToolCalls(messages: readonly Message[], onAnomaly?: OnAnomaly): Message[] {
168	  const seenToolCallIds = new Set<string>();
169	  const keptToolResultIndexes = new Map<string, number>();
170	  const out: Message[] = [];
171	  for (const message of messages) {
172	    if (message.role === 'assistant' && message.toolCalls.length > 0) {
173	      const kept = message.toolCalls.filter((toolCall) => {
174	        if (seenToolCallIds.has(toolCall.id)) {
175	          onAnomaly?.({ kind: 'duplicate_tool_call_dropped', toolCallId: toolCall.id });
176	          return false;
177	        }
178	        seenToolCallIds.add(toolCall.id);
179	        return true;
180	      });
181	      if (kept.length === message.toolCalls.length) {
182	        out.push(message);
183	      } else if (kept.length > 0 || message.content.length > 0) {
184	        out.push({ ...message, toolCalls: kept });
185	      }
186	      continue;
187	    }
188	    if (message.role === 'tool' && message.toolCallId !== undefined) {
189	      const previousIndex = keptToolResultIndexes.get(message.toolCallId);
190	      if (previousIndex !== undefined) {
191	        if (isInterruptedToolResult(out[previousIndex]) && !isInterruptedToolResult(message)) {
192	          out[previousIndex] = message;
193	        } else {
194	          onAnomaly?.({ kind: 'duplicate_tool_result_dropped', toolCallId: message.toolCallId });
195	        }
196	        continue;
197	      }
198	      keptToolResultIndexes.set(message.toolCallId, out.length);
199	    }
200	    out.push(message);
201	  }
202	  return out;
203	}

205	function mergeConsecutiveAssistantMessages(
206	  messages: readonly Message[],
207	  onAnomaly?: OnAnomaly,
208	): Message[] {
209	  const out: Message[] = [];
210	  for (const message of messages) {
211	    const previous = out.at(-1);
212	    if (previous !== undefined && previous.role === 'assistant' && message.role === 'assistant') {
213	      out[out.length - 1] = {
214	        ...previous,
215	        content: [...previous.content, ...message.content],
216	        toolCalls: [...previous.toolCalls, ...message.toolCalls],
217	      };
218	      onAnomaly?.({ kind: 'consecutive_assistants_merged' });
219	      continue;
220	    }
221	    out.push(message);
222	  }
223	  return out;

226	function dropLeadingNonUserMessages(messages: readonly Message[], onAnomaly?: OnAnomaly): Message[] {
227	  let start = 0;

229	    onAnomaly?.({ kind: 'leading_non_user_dropped', role: messages[start]!.role });
230	    start += 1;

232	  return start === 0 ? [...messages] : messages.slice(start);

235	// Projects the stored context history into the wire messages sent to the
236	// model, in a single pass over the history.
237	//
238	// Strict providers require every tool call to be answered right after the
239	// assistant message, so each call is closed on the spot with a synthetic
240	// interrupted result and its slot in the output stays open until the recorded
241	// result overwrites it in place. A call stays open until its first result; a
242	// call id reused by a later assistant re-targets the slots that follow.
243	// Partial messages (stream interrupted) are invisible here, so their calls
244	// never anchor an exchange. Tool messages are skipped where they originally
245	// sat — a result either lands in its call's slot or it is an orphan,
246	// wire-invalid and useless to the model. A history with no assistant at all
247	// is a bare sizing slice and passes through as-is. Emitting cleans each message (drops empty /
248	// whitespace-only text blocks, rejected by strict providers), merges runs of
249	// adjacent user prompts (accumulated and materialized once per run), and
250	// strips context-only metadata off the wire.
251	//
252	// Every repair that changes what the model sees (a displaced result pulled up,
253	// a lost result synthesized, an orphan dropped, blank text dropped) is reported
254	// through `onAnomaly`; the projection stays a pure transform and the caller
255	// decides whether to surface the trace.
256	//
257	// The projected messages share their content parts and tool calls with the
258	// stored context (only the top-level wrapper is rebuilt); consumers must
259	// treat the projection as read-only, which every provider conversion already
260	// honors by building fresh structures.
261	function project(history: readonly ContextMessage[], onAnomaly?: OnAnomaly): Message[] {
262	  const hasAssistant = history.some(
263	    (message) => message.partial !== true && message.role === 'assistant',
264	  );
265	
266	  // Last history index that is a real, non-tool turn. A call still open at the
267	  // end whose owning assistant sits at/after it closed a trailing, possibly
268	  // in-flight call (expected); one whose owner precedes it lost its result
269	  // mid-history (a defect). Mirrors the trailing/mid-history split used to keep
270	  // the trace free of routine in-flight closes.
271	  let lastNonToolIndex = history.length - 1;
272	  while (
273	    lastNonToolIndex >= 0 &&
274	    (history[lastNonToolIndex]?.role === 'tool' || history[lastNonToolIndex]?.partial === true)
275	  ) {
276	    lastNonToolIndex -= 1;
277	  }
278	
279	  const out: Message[] = [];
280	  const openSlots = new Map<string, OpenSlot>();
281	  let merge: MergeGroup | undefined;
282	
283	  const flushMerge = (): void => {
284	    if (merge === undefined) return;
285	    if (merge.singleContent === undefined) {
286	      const text = merge.texts.join('\n\n');
287	      const content: ContentPart[] = text === '' ? [] : [{ type: 'text', text }];
288	      content.push(...merge.parts);
289	      out[merge.index] = {
290	        role: 'user',
291	        name: undefined,
292	        content,
293	        toolCalls: [],
294	        toolCallId: undefined,

296	      };
297	    }
298	    merge = undefined;
299	  };
300	
301	  // A real (non-tool) message — or a result for an unknown call — landing while
302	  // calls are still open means those calls' results were not adjacent in the
303	  // stored history; pulling them up is a real repair worth tracing.
304	  const markForeignBetween = (): void => {
305	    for (const slot of openSlots.values()) slot.foreignBetween = true;
306	  };
307	
308	  const emit = (source: ContextMessage): void => {
309	    const content = projectedContent(source, onAnomaly);
310	    if (content.length === 0 && source.toolCalls.length === 0) return;
311	
312	    if (openSlots.size > 0) markForeignBetween();
313	
314	    if (canMergeUserMessage(source)) {

316	        out.push(toWireMessage(source, content));

320	          appendMergeContent(merge, merge.singleContent);

325	      return;
326	    }

328	    out.push(toWireMessage(source, content));

333	    if (message.role === 'tool') {

352	    emit(message);

392	// Join only the non-empty texts so merging an image-only message never

394	function appendMergeContent(group: MergeGroup, content: readonly ContentPart[]): void {

function projectStrict(history: readonly ContextMessage[]): Message[] {
  const projected = project(history);
  return dropLeadingNonUserMessages(mergeConsecutiveAssistantMessages(dedupeDuplicateToolCalls(projected)));
}

function dedupeDuplicateToolCalls(messages: readonly Message[]): Message[] {
  const seenToolCallIds = new Set<string>();
  const keptToolResultIndexes = new Map<string, number>();
  const out: Message[] = [];
  for (const message of messages) {
    if (message.role === 'assistant' && message.toolCalls.length > 0) {
      const kept = message.toolCalls.filter((toolCall) => {
        if (seenToolCallIds.has(toolCall.id)) return false;
        seenToolCallIds.add(toolCall.id);
        return true;
      });
      if (kept.length === message.toolCalls.length) {
        out.push(message);
      } else if (kept.length > 0 || message.content.length > 0) {
        out.push({ ...message, toolCalls: kept });
      }
      continue;
    }
    if (message.role === 'tool' && message.toolCallId !== undefined) {
      const previousIndex = keptToolResultIndexes.get(message.toolCallId);
      if (previousIndex !== undefined) {
        if (isInterruptedToolResult(out[previousIndex]) && !isInterruptedToolResult(message)) {
          out[previousIndex] = message;
        }
        continue;

136	  private async requestWithRetry(
137	    overrides: LLMRequestOverrides,
138	    onPart: LLMRequestPartHandler,
139	    signal: AbortSignal | undefined,
140	  ): Promise<LLMRequestFinish> {
141	    const startedAt = Date.now();
142	    const maxAttempts = Math.max(overrides.retry?.maxAttempts ?? DEFAULT_MAX_RETRY_ATTEMPTS, 1);
143	
144	    if (maxAttempts <= 1) {
145	      try {
146	        return await this.executeRequestAttempt(overrides, onPart, signal, 1, maxAttempts);
147	      } catch (error) {
148	        this.logRequestFailure(error, overrides, signal, 1, maxAttempts);
149	        this.trackApiError(error, startedAt, signal);
150	        throw error;
151	      }
152	    }
153	
154	    const delays = retryBackoffDelays(maxAttempts);
155	    for (let attempt = 1; ; attempt += 1) {
156	      try {
157	        return await this.executeRequestAttempt(overrides, onPart, signal, attempt, maxAttempts);
158	      } catch (error) {
159	        if (attempt >= maxAttempts || !isRetryableGenerateError(error)) {
160	          this.logRequestFailure(error, overrides, signal, attempt, maxAttempts);
161	          this.trackApiError(error, startedAt, signal);
162	          throw error;
163	        }
164	
165	        signal?.throwIfAborted();
166	        const delayMs = delays[attempt - 1] ?? 0;
167	        await overrides.retry?.onRetry?.({
168	          failedAttempt: attempt,
169	          nextAttempt: attempt + 1,
170	          maxAttempts,
171	          delayMs,
172	          ...retryErrorFields(error),
173	        });
174	        await sleepForRetry(delayMs, signal);
175	      }
176	    }
177	  }

179	  private async executeRequestAttempt(

186	    signal?.throwIfAborted();
187	    const request = this.resolveRequest(
188	      overrides,
189	      attempt === 1 ? undefined : { attempt: `${String(attempt)}/${String(maxAttempts)}` },
190	    );
191	    return this.runRequest(request, onPart, signal);
192	  }

import { IInstantiationService } from "#/_base/di/instantiation";
import { InstantiationType } from '#/_base/di/extensions';
import { LifecycleScope, registerScopedService } from '#/_base/di/scope';
import type { ContextMessage } from '#/agent/contextMemory/types';
import { ErrorCodes, KimiError } from '#/errors';
import { IAgentMicroCompactionService } from '#/agent/microCompaction/microCompaction';
import { isSpineEnabled } from '#/agent/spine/flag';
import { IAgentSpineService } from '#/agent/spine/spine';
import type { ContentPart, Message } from '#/app/llmProtocol/message';
import { IAgentContextProjectorService } from './contextProjector';

export class AgentContextProjectorService implements IAgentContextProjectorService {
  declare readonly _serviceBrand: undefined;
  constructor(
    @IInstantiationService private readonly instantiation: IInstantiationService,
  ) {}

  project(messages: readonly ContextMessage[]): readonly Message[] {
    return project(this.foldSpine(this.microCompaction().compact(messages)));
  }

  projectStrict(messages: readonly ContextMessage[]): readonly Message[] {
    return projectStrict(this.foldSpine(this.microCompaction().compact(messages)));
  }

  private foldSpine(messages: readonly ContextMessage[]): readonly ContextMessage[] {

699	function findAPIStatusError(error: unknown): APIStatusError | undefined {
700	  let current: unknown = error;
701	  const seen = new Set<unknown>();
702	  while (current !== undefined && current !== null && !seen.has(current)) {
703	    if (current instanceof APIStatusError) return current;
704	    seen.add(current);
705	    current = current instanceof Error ? current.cause : undefined;
706	  }
707	  return undefined;
708	}

710	function collectSummary(finish: LLMRequestFinish): CompactionAttemptResult {
711	  if (finish.providerFinishReason === 'truncated') {
712	    throw new CompactionTruncatedError();
713	  }
714	
715	  const summary = finish.message.content
716	    .filter((part) => part.type === 'text')
717	    .map((part) => part.text)
718	    .join('')
719	    .trim();
720	  if (summary.length === 0) {
721	    throw new APIEmptyResponseError(
722	      'The compaction response did not contain a non-empty summary.',
723	    );
724	  }
725	
726	  return { summary, usage: finish.usage };
727	}

730	  current: readonly ContextMessage[],

732	): boolean {
733	  if (current.length < original.length) return false;
734	  if (!original.every((message, index) => message === current[index])) return false;

740	function stripDynamicToolContext(
741	  history: readonly ContextMessage[],
742	): readonly ContextMessage[] {
743	  if (!history.some((message) => hasDynamicToolSchema(message) || isLoadableToolsAnnouncement(message))) {
744	    return history;
745	  }
746	  const out: ContextMessage[] = [];
747	  for (const message of history) {
748	    if (isLoadableToolsAnnouncement(message)) continue;
749	    if (hasDynamicToolSchema(message)) {
750	      const { tools: _tools, ...rest } = message;
751	      void _tools;
752	      if (rest.content.length === 0 && rest.toolCalls.length === 0) continue;
753	      out.push(rest);
754	      continue;
755	    }
756	    out.push(message);
757	  }
758	  return out;
759	}

761	function hasDynamicToolSchema(message: ContextMessage): boolean {
762	  return message.tools !== undefined && message.tools.length > 0;
763	}

765	function isLoadableToolsAnnouncement(message: ContextMessage): boolean {

768	  );

771	function shrinkCompactionHistoryAfterOverflow<T extends Message>(
772	  messages: readonly T[],
773	  attempt: number,
774	): T[] {
775	  if (messages.length <= 1) return messages.slice();
776	  const ratio = COMPACTION_OVERFLOW_SHRINK_RATIOS[
777	    Math.min(attempt - 1, COMPACTION_OVERFLOW_SHRINK_RATIOS.length - 1)
778	  ]!;
779	  const tokenBudget = Math.floor(estimateTokensForMessages(messages) * ratio);
780	  return takeRecentMessagesWithinTokenBudget(messages, tokenBudget);
781	}
782	
783	function takeRecentMessagesWithinTokenBudget<T extends Message>(
784	  messages: readonly T[],
785	  tokenBudget: number,
786	): T[] {
787	  let start = messages.length;
788	  let tokens = 0;
789	  for (let i = messages.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
790	    const messageTokens = estimateTokensForMessage(messages[i]!);
791	    if (tokens + messageTokens > tokenBudget) break;
792	    tokens += messageTokens;
793	    start = i;
794	  }
795	  if (start === 0) start = 1;
796	  return dropLeadingToolResults(messages.slice(start));
797	}
798	
799	function dropOldestMessageAndLeadingToolResults<T extends { readonly role: string }>(
800	  messages: readonly T[],
801	): T[] {
802	  if (messages.length <= 1) return messages.slice();
803	  return dropLeadingToolResults(messages.slice(1));
804	}
805	
806	function dropLeadingToolResults<T extends { readonly role: string }>(messages: readonly T[]): T[] {
807	  let start = 0;
808	  while (start < messages.length && messages[start]!.role === 'tool') {
809	    start += 1;
810	  }
811	  return messages.slice(start);
812	}

#!/usr/bin/env node
/**
 * Domain-layer import boundary checker for `agent-core-v2`.
 *
 * Enforces two rules over `packages/agent-core-v2/src/**` (and the v1-import
 * ban over `test/**` too):
 *
 *  1. **No v1 imports** — v2 must never `import '@moonshot-ai/agent-core'`
 *     (or any subpath). v2 ports logic; it never depends on v1.
 *  2. **Domain layering** — a domain at layer L may only import domains at
 *     layer `<= L`. Lower layers must not reach upward. See
 *     `plan/PLAN.md` §3 / §5 for the layer table.
 *
 * Intra-package relative imports and `#/`-alias imports are resolved to a
 * domain by the first path segment under `src/`. Sibling packages
 * (`@moonshot-ai/*` other than v1) and third-party imports are out of scope.
 *
 * Run: `node scripts/check-domain-layers.mjs`. Exits non-zero on violation.
 */

import { readFileSync, readdirSync, statSync } from 'node:fs';
import { dirname, join, relative, resolve } from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';

const __dirname = dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url));
const PKG_ROOT = resolve(__dirname, '..');
export const SRC_ROOT = join(PKG_ROOT, 'src');
const TEST_ROOT = join(PKG_ROOT, 'test');

/**
 * Domain → layer. A domain may only import domains at its own layer or lower.
 * Keep in sync with `plan/PLAN.md` §3. Domains not listed here that appear
 * under `src/` are reported so the table stays current.
 */
const DOMAIN_LAYER = new Map([
  // L0 — base infrastructure
  ['_base', 0],
  // `_base/execEnv` (pure execution-env helpers such as
  // `probeHostEnvironmentFromNode`, `decodeTextWithErrors`,
  // `globPatternToRegex`, `BufferedReadable`) sits under `_base/*`, so the
  // `_base` L0 entry already covers it — no separate entry needed.
  // `errors` is a top-level facade (src/errors.ts) that aggregates every
  // domain's error codes; any domain may import it, so it sits at L0.
  ['errors', 0],
  // `llmProtocol` is v2's public wire-type namespace (`Message`,
  // `ContentPart`, `Tool`, `TokenUsage`, `FinishReason`, error classes,
  // etc.). It has no v2 dependencies of its own (it vendors the kosong wire
  // implementation directly within `llmProtocol`); every domain — including
  // `_base/utils/tokens` and `_base/errors/serialize` — may import wire types
  // through it, so it sits at L0.
  ['llmProtocol', 0],
  // L1 — abstraction bridges & low-level capabilities
  ['log', 1],
  ['sessionLog', 1],
  ['telemetry', 1],
  ['bootstrap', 1],
  // `environment` is the App-scope resolved startup snapshot: host facts, the
  // app path layout, and the env bag; low-level substrate that any domain may
  // read for paths/facts, so it sits in L1 beside `bootstrap` and the
  // `os/interface` host facts.

1	/**
2	 * `todo` domain (L4) — `ISessionTodoService` implementation.
3	 *
4	 * Holds the session's shared todo list as a stateless facade over the main
5	 * agent's `TodoModel`: `getTodos` reads `wire.getModel(TodoModel)` live, and
6	 * every mutation only dispatches a `tools.update_store` Op to the main agent's
7	 * wire (the
8	 * single source of truth and replayable timeline); `onDidChange` is bridged
9	 * from `wire.subscribe(TodoModel)`. The service keeps no list copy of its own,
10	 * so the live view and the post-replay view can never drift. Binds the
11	 * `TodoListTool` and the stale-todo reminder into every agent (`onDidCreate`),
12	 * and the model subscription into the main agent (`onDidCreateMain`),
13	 * borrowing each agent's services through its `IAgentScopeHandle.accessor`.
14	 * Per-agent bindings are disposed when the agent is disposed. Bound at Session
15	 * scope.
16	 *
17	 * Debt: the session's todo list is still persisted on the MAIN agent's wire (a
18	 * Session → Agent edge), so it follows the main agent's lifetime. Once
19	 * `ISessionWireService` is wired up with its own log + replay, move `TodoModel`
20	 * there — swap `@IAgentWireService` for `@ISessionWireService` and drop the
21	 * main-agent subscription. The stateless facade makes that a one-line change.
22	 */
23	
24	import { Disposable, toDisposable, type IDisposable } from '#/_base/di/lifecycle';
25	import { InstantiationType } from '#/_base/di/extensions';
26	import { type IAgentScopeHandle, LifecycleScope, registerScopedService } from '#/_base/di/scope';
27	import { Emitter } from '#/_base/event';
28	
29	import { IAgentContextInjectorService } from '#/agent/contextInjector/contextInjector';
30	import { IAgentContextMemoryService } from '#/agent/contextMemory/contextMemory';
31	import { IAgentProfileService } from '#/agent/profile/profile';
32	import { isSpineEnabled } from '#/agent/spine/flag';
33	import { IAgentLifecycleService } from '#/session/agentLifecycle/agentLifecycle';
34	import { IAgentWireService } from '#/wire/tokens';
35	
36	import { ISessionTodoService } from './sessionTodo';
37	import { TodoModel, todoSet } from './todoOps';
38	import { TODO_LIST_TOOL_NAME, type TodoItem } from './todoItem';
39	import { TODO_LIST_REMINDER_VARIANT, todoListStaleReminder } from './todoListReminder';
40	
41	declare module '#/agent/wireRecord/wireRecord' {
42	  interface WireRecordMap {
43	    'tools.update_store': {
44	      key: string;
45	      value: unknown;
46	    };
47	  }
48	}
49	
50	const MAIN_AGENT_ID = 'main';
51	
52	export class SessionTodoService extends Disposable implements ISessionTodoService {
53	  declare readonly _serviceBrand: undefined;
54	
55	  private readonly onDidChangeEmitter = this._register(new Emitter<readonly TodoItem[]>());
56	  readonly onDidChange = this.onDidChangeEmitter.event;
57	
58	  /** Per-agent bindings (reminder per agent, plus the model subscription for main). */
59	  private readonly agentBindings = new Map<string, IDisposable[]>();
60	
61	  constructor(
62	    @IAgentLifecycleService private readonly agentLifecycle: IAgentLifecycleService,
63	  ) {
64	    super();
65	
66	    this._register(this.agentLifecycle.onDidCreate((handle) => this.bindAgent(handle)));
67	    this._register(this.agentLifecycle.onDidCreateMain((handle) => this.bindMainWire(handle)));
68	    this._register(
69	      this.agentLifecycle.onDidDispose((agentId) => this.disposeAgentBindings(agentId)),
70	    );
71	
72	    for (const handle of this.agentLifecycle.list()) {
73	      this.bindAgent(handle);
74	    }
75	    const main = this.agentLifecycle.getHandle(MAIN_AGENT_ID);
76	    if (main !== undefined) {
77	      this.bindMainWire(main);
78	    }
79	
80	    this._register(
81	      toDisposable(() => {
82	        for (const agentId of Array.from(this.agentBindings.keys())) {
83	          this.disposeAgentBindings(agentId);
84	        }
85	      }),
86	    );
87	  }
88	
89	  getTodos(): readonly TodoItem[] {
90	    const main = this.agentLifecycle.getHandle(MAIN_AGENT_ID);
91	    if (main === undefined) return [];
92	    return main.accessor.get(IAgentWireService).getModel(TodoModel);
93	  }
94	
95	  setTodos(todos: readonly TodoItem[]): void {
96	    const next: readonly TodoItem[] = todos.map((todo) => ({
97	      title: todo.title,
98	      status: todo.status,
99	    }));
100	    this.dispatchTodoSet(next);
101	  }
102	
103	  clear(): void {
104	    this.setTodos([]);
105	  }
106	
107	  private dispatchTodoSet(todos: readonly TodoItem[]): void {
108	    const main = this.agentLifecycle.getHandle(MAIN_AGENT_ID);
109	    if (main === undefined) return;
110	    const wire = main.accessor.get(IAgentWireService);
111	    wire.dispatch(todoSet({ key: 'todo', value: todos }));
112	  }
113	
114	  private bindMainWire(handle: IAgentScopeHandle): void {
115	    const wire = handle.accessor.get(IAgentWireService);
116	    // Registered on the main agent's wire by `onDidCreateMain`, which fires in
117	    // `ensureMainAgent` strictly before that wire's `replay`. Bridge model
118	    // changes to `onDidChange`: replay applies silently (no notification), so
119	    // this fires only for live `tools.update_store` (`key: 'todo'`) writes, carrying the sanitized model.
120	    const disposable = wire.subscribe(TodoModel, (state) => {
121	      this.onDidChangeEmitter.fire(state);
122	    });
123	    this.trackAgentBinding(handle.id, disposable);
124	  }
125	
126	  private bindAgent(handle: IAgentScopeHandle): void {
127	    const injector = handle.accessor.get(IAgentContextInjectorService);
128	    this.trackAgentBinding(
129	      handle.id,
130	      injector.register(TODO_LIST_REMINDER_VARIANT, () => this.staleReminder(handle)),
131	    );
132	  }
133	
134	  private staleReminder(handle: IAgentScopeHandle): string | undefined {
135	    const memory = handle.accessor.get(IAgentContextMemoryService);
136	    const profile = handle.accessor.get(IAgentProfileService);
137	    return todoListStaleReminder({
138	      // Spine replaces the flat todo list as the model's progress tracker
139	      // (the tool itself is gated off via `registerTool(..., { when })` in
140	      // `todo-list`), so the "update your todo list" nudge must stay silent
141	      // too — otherwise the model gets prodded toward a tool it no longer has.
142	      active: !isSpineEnabled() && profile.isToolActive(TODO_LIST_TOOL_NAME, 'builtin'),
143	      history: memory.get(),
144	      todos: this.getTodos(),
145	    });
146	  }
147	
148	  private trackAgentBinding(agentId: string, disposable: IDisposable): void {
149	    const list = this.agentBindings.get(agentId);
150	    if (list === undefined) {
151	      this.agentBindings.set(agentId, [disposable]);
152	    } else {
153	      list.push(disposable);
154	    }
155	  }
156	
157	  private disposeAgentBindings(agentId: string): void {
158	    const bindings = this.agentBindings.get(agentId);
159	    if (bindings === undefined) return;
160	    for (const disposable of bindings) {
161	      disposable.dispose();
162	    }
163	    this.agentBindings.delete(agentId);
164	  }
165	}
166	
167	registerScopedService(
168	  LifecycleScope.Session,
169	  ISessionTodoService,
170	  SessionTodoService,
171	  InstantiationType.Eager,
172	  'todo',
173	);

```ts
import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';

import { MASTER_ENV } from '#/app/flag/flagService';
import { IAgentWireService, SpineModel } from '#/index';

import { testAgent, type TestAgentContext } from '../harness';

const SPINE_ENV = 'KIMI_CODE_SPINE';
const MINUTE = 60 * 1000;

const CATALOGUED_PROVIDER = {
  type: 'kimi',
  apiKey: 'test-key',
  model: 'kimi-code',
  baseUrl: 'http://127.1',
} as const;
const CATALOGUED_MODEL_CAPABILITIES = {
  image_in: true,
  video_in: true,
  audio_in: false,
  thinking: true,
  tool_use: true,
  max_context_tokens: 256_000,
} as const;

describe('Spine / compaction interaction', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    vi.stubEnv(MASTER_ENV, '0');
    vi.stubEnv(SPINE_ENV, '1');
  });
  afterEach(() => {
    vi.unstubAllEnvs();
    vi.useRealTimers();
  });

  it('routes full compaction into a spine root epoch instead of rebuilding history', async () => {
    vi.useFakeTimers();
    const ctx = testAgent();
    ctx.configure({ provider: CATALOGUED_PROVIDER, modelCapabilities: CATALOGUED_MODEL_CAPABILITIES });

    vi.setSystemTime(0);
    ctx.appendExchange(1, 'old user', 'old assistant', 20);
    ctx.appendExchange(2, 'recent user', 'recent assistant', 80);

    vi.setSystemTime(61 * MINUTE);
    const completed = ctx.once('full_compaction.complete');
    ctx.mockNextResponse({ type: 'text', text: 'Summary.' });
    await ctx.rpc.beginCompaction({});
    await completed;

    const recordTypes = ctx.recordHistory.map((record) => record.type);
    expect(recordTypes).toContain('spine.root_compact');
    expect(recordTypes).not.toContain('context.apply_compaction');

    const state = readSpine(ctx);
    expect(state.rootEpoch).toBe(2);
    expect(state.openStack).toEqual(['2', '2.1']);
    expect(state.epochMemoryAt).toBeDefined();

    const lastMessage = ctx.context.get().at(-1);
    expect(lastMessage?.origin?.kind).toBe('compaction_summary');
    expect(textOf(lastMessage)).toContain('Summary.');

    const projected = ctx.project();
    expect(projected.some((m) => textOf(m).includes('old assistant'))).toBe(false);
    expect(textOf(projected[0])).toContain('Summary.');
  });
});

function readSpine(ctx: TestAgentContext) {
  return ctx.get(IAgentWireService).getModel(SpineModel);
}

function textOf(message: { content?: readonly { type: string; text?: string }[] } | undefined): string {
  return (
    message?.content
      ?.map((part) => (part.type === 'text' ? (part.text ?? '') : ''))
      .join('') ?? ''
  );
}
```

```
  private applyRootCompaction(
    summary: string,
    compactedCount: number,
    tokensBefore: number,
  ): CompactionResult {
    const contextSummary = buildCompactionSummaryText(summary);
    const summaryMessage = createCompactionSummaryMessage(contextSummary);
    const summaryAt = this.context.get().length;
    this.context.append(summaryMessage);
    const epochStartAt = this.context.get().length;
    const tokensAfter = estimateTokensForMessages([summaryMessage]);
    const spineState = this.wire.getModel(SpineModel);
    this.wire.dispatch(
      spineRootCompact({
        epoch: spineState.rootEpoch + 1,
        epochStartAt,
        epochMemoryAt: summaryAt,
      }),
      contextSizeMeasured({ length: epochStartAt, tokens: tokensAfter }),
    );
    return {
      summary,
      contextSummary,
      compactedCount,
      tokensBefore,
      tokensAfter,
      keptUserMessageCount: 0,
      droppedCount: compactedCount,
    };
  }
```

 apps/kimi-code/src/main.ts | 6 ++++++

== spine flag mechanism ==
/**
 * `spine` domain (L4) — independent environment gate for the spine experiment.
 *
 * Reads `KIMI_CODE_SPINE` directly from the environment rather than the `flag`
 * registry: the registry's master switch (`KIMI_CODE_EXPERIMENTAL_FLAG`, which
 * also enables the v2 engine itself) is force-on with no opt-out, so routing
 * spine through it would turn spine on for every v2 user. An independent env
 * keeps "using v2" and "using spine" as separate choices. Pure configuration,
 * no IO.
 */

export const SPINE_ENV = 'KIMI_CODE_SPINE';

const TRUTHY_VALUES = new Set(['1', 'true', 'yes', 'on']);

export function isSpineEnabled(
  env: Readonly<Record<string, string | undefined>> = process.env,
): boolean {
  return TRUTHY_VALUES.has((env[SPINE_ENV] ?? '').trim().toLowerCase());
}

# Enforce LF line endings in the working tree on every platform so that
# raw-imported text (e.g. `*.md?raw` templates) is byte-identical on Windows

/**

  'metadata',
  'forked',

  'turn.steer',
  'turn.cancel',

  'permission.set_mode',
  'permission.record_approval_result',
  'full_compaction.begin',

  'swarm_mode.enter',
  'swarm_mode.exit',
  'tools.register_user_tool',
  'tools.unregister_user_tool',
  'tools.set_active_tools',
  'tools.update_store',
  'usage.record',
  'context.append_message',
  'context.append_loop_event',
  'context.clear',
  'context.apply_compaction',
  'context.undo',
  'goal.create',
  'goal.update',
  'goal.clear',
  'llm.tools_snapshot',
  'llm.request',
  'mcp.tools_discovered',
]);

  const SCOPE = 'wire';
  const KEY = 'v1-vocabulary-test';

  let disposables: DisposableStore;
  let wire: WireService;
  let log: IAppendLogStore;

  beforeEach(() => {
    disposables = new DisposableStore();
    const ix = disposables.add(new TestInstantiationService());
    ix.stub(IFileSystemStorageService, new InMemoryStorageService());
    ix.set(IAppendLogStore, new SyncDescriptor(AppendLogStore));
    ix.set(IAgentWireService, new SyncDescriptor(WireService, [{ logScope: SCOPE, logKey: KEY }]));
    wire = ix.get(IAgentWireService) as WireService;
    log = ix.get(IAppendLogStore);
  });

  afterEach(() => disposables.dispose());

  async function readRecords(): Promise<PersistedRecord[]> {
    await wire.flush();
    const out: PersistedRecord[] = [];
    for await (const record of log.read<PersistedRecord>(SCOPE, KEY)) {
      out.push(record);
    }
    return out;
  }

  it('every persisted op type is a v1 record type', () => {
    for (const [type, descriptor] of OP_REGISTRY) {
      if (descriptor.persist === false) continue;
      expect(V1_RECORD_TYPES.has(type), `op "${type}" persists a non-v1 record type`).toBe(true);
    }
  });

  it('stamps persisted records with time, except the metadata envelope', async () => {

async function configureLoop(ctx: TestAgentContext): Promise<void> {
  ctx.configure({ provider: CATALOGUED_PROVIDER, modelCapabilities: CATALOGUED_MODEL_CAPABILITIES });
  await ctx.rpc.setPermission({ mode: 'yolo' });
}

function readSpine(ctx: TestAgentContext) {
  return ctx.get(IAgentWireService).getModel(SpineModel);
}

function recordingHostFs(writes: Map<string, string>) {
  return {
    writeText: async (path: string, data: string) => {
      writes.set(path, data);
    },
    mkdir: async () => {},
  };
}

function toolCallPart(
  id: string,
  name: string,
  args: Record<string, unknown>,
): { readonly type: 'function'; readonly id: string; readonly name: string; readonly arguments: string } {
  return { type: 'function', id, name, arguments: JSON.stringify(args) };
}

function cloneRecords<T>(records: readonly T[]): T[] {
  return records.map((record) => structuredClone(record));
}

// ── formatting helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────────

function buildProfileDescriptions(
  profiles: readonly AgentProfile[],
): string {
  return profiles
    .map((profile) => {
      const details = [profile.description, profile.whenToUse].filter(
        (part): part is string => part !== undefined && part.length > 0,
      );
      const header = details.length === 0 ? `- ${profile.name}` : `- ${profile.name}: ${details.join(' ')}`;
      if (profile.tools.length === 0) {
        return header;
      }
      return `${header}\n  Tools: ${profile.tools.join(', ')}`;
    })
    .join('\n');
}

function formatBackgroundAgentResult(
  taskId: string,
  handle: SubagentHandle,
  description: string,
  allowBackground: boolean,
): string {
  return [
    `task_id: ${taskId}`,
    'status: running',
    `agent_id: ${handle.agentId}`,
    `actual_subagent_type: ${handle.profileName}`,
    'automatic_notification: true',
